blocks.orig: The Lake Natron Camp of Ngare Sero sits in the remote wilderness near Lake Natron, surrounded by rugged volcanic landscapes. The solar-powered camp offers 10 guest tents (5 luxury tents, 3 suites, and 1 double suite), each lavishly decorated and set up with a king-size bed and an ensuite bathroom with shower and portable eco-friendly compost toilet (similar to those in campers). Attached to the tent is a porch with seats to let you enjoy the incredible view, and a short private path from each tent leads to a natural pool fed by a freshwater spring. Meals are served in the mess tent with panoramic views of the Great Rift Valley, Ol Doinyo Lengai, and the (at times) flamingo-filled shores of Lake Natron.
blocks.html: In the remote wilderness close to Lake Natron, surrounded by rugged volcanic scenery, you find the Lake Natron Camp of Ngare Sero. This solar-powered camp has 10 guest tents (5 luxury tents, 3 suites and 1 double suite), all richly furnished, each with a king-size bed and an ensuite bathroom with a shower and a portable eco-friendly compost toilet (like the ones in campervans). Every tent has a porch with seating where you can take in the amazing view, and from each tent a short private path takes you to a natural pool fed by a freshwater spring. You eat in the mess tent, which has panoramic views of the Great Rift Valley, Ol Doinyo Lengai and the shores of Lake Natron, which are (at times) full of flamingos.
